people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”
translations.bsb: So Pilate questioned Him, “Are You the King of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
